desc:
🔩 Welcome to +1 Screwdriver Arm! 🔩

Unscrew everything! Run down the endless corridor, let your screwdriver arms unscrew thousands of colorful screws and bolts, level up and grow MORE ARMS!

🦾 Every level makes you stronger: +1 screwdriver arm, longer reach, faster unscrewing
⚠️ Giant rollers are coming! Hide in a safe spot or get sent back to the lobby
🪙 Find gold plates deep in the corridor and bring the gold home
🎨 Unlock skins and upgrades in the shop
♻️ Rebirth for permanent point multipliers
🎁 Daily rewards, AFK boards and global leaderboards
🗺️ New stages the further you go. How deep can you unscrew?

👍 Like and favorite the game for more updates!
👥 Join the Unscrew Empire group for news
